title: ExplainerCreateOutput
description: Result of explainer_create. Shape from max/server/explainer_mcp.py:333-347, with write_source_to made optional because only a local backend can hand back a path the agent may write to directly.

created.description: Wiring files written by this call, by filename.

already_present.description: Wiring files left untouched because they already existed. The scaffold never overwrites.

write_source_to.description: Local backends only: absolute directory the agent may write Video.tsx and scene files into. Absent on hosted backends, where explainer_put_source is the only way in.

put_media_in.description: Where media for this video belongs. A path on a local backend; the token to pass to explainer_put_media on a hosted one.

next.description: Ordered next actions, phrased for an agent to follow.
